# formzolo — product facts

> A sign-in CV builder with free clean Color and Plain PDF downloads and local document-to-profile field-mapping assistance.

Reviewed snapshot: 2026-11-07T17:26:14.162007+00:00. Existing brand aliases: FormZalo, formzalo, CV Studio.

## Free CV builder
- Sign-in is required for the editor and current free download UI.
- Color PDF and Plain PDF downloads are free and have no watermark. Three templates: meridian, consulate, atlas.
- The current free UI does not establish a free Word/DOCX download.
- No numerical daily quota was found in the direct browser PDF path. This is not an unlimited-service promise. Device resources and input limits apply.

## Document reading and local form assistance
- Input size limit: 12582912 bytes (12 MiB). Scanned-PDF OCR fallback reads at most 2 pages.
- OCR is initialized with English (eng). PDF text/image/plain-text input is processed on-device; OCR resources may require network downloads.
- Field detection, document-to-profile proposals, user review, missing-detail prompts and shared profile editing exist.
- Arbitrary third-party job submission, automatic application completion and writing back into any uploaded PDF are not verified.
- No active generative-model integration was established. AI resume writing is not a verified live capability.

## Paid plans and availability
- At 2026-11-07T17:26:14.162007+00:00, public checkout reported mode=unavailable, trialMode=true, provider=null.
- Paid form-filler plans exist in source; checkout availability must be rechecked before promotion. Legacy paid-export prices/download limits are not free-PDF limits.

## Languages
- Eight UI locale IDs across seven base languages: en, en-GB, hi, ar, zh-CN, es-ES, fr-FR, ja.
- CV heading options are separate: en, fr, de, es. UI support is not proof of multilingual OCR or PDF glyph coverage.
- Five public content locales (en, hi, pl, ar, es) have independent SSR pages. The legacy editor language architecture and Unicode PDF validation remain separate.
- The sitemap lists thirty active localized public pages and twelve existing English content pages. Seven later public locale collections are not implemented.

## Contact
- Published support contact: team@formzalo.com; https://formzalo.com/services. Mailbox deliverability was not tested; no email was sent.

## Discovery limitation
These voluntary AI-readable assets do not guarantee discovery, crawling, indexing, retrieval, citation, ranking or recommendation. They are not a special Google ranking requirement.
## Detailed capability record

Available local assistance steps: detect requested fields; propose profile values from document text; review and apply selected values; ask for missing details; edit shared profile fields.
Local field mapping is not a promise to submit external applications or write back into any uploaded PDF. Paid server credit APIs exist; the inspected local UI did not establish the completed paid-fill integration.

UI translation support does not establish multilingual OCR or full-document scanned-PDF processing.
Five locale-prefixed public content collections have request-scoped SSR. Existing editor UI remains eight locale IDs; Polish public content opens the English editor. Legacy app locale behavior and Unicode PDF validation are separate, incomplete work.
Generated from active public counterparts and existing English-only content. No absent/untranslated locale routes or lastmod dates are emitted. Seven later public locales are not indexed by this batch.

## Crawling versus training
Generated training policy defaults to allow, preserving the prior public decision. Every named allow group repeats the wildcard sensitive-path exclusions.
Search, model training, user-initiated fetching and grounding are distinct. Google-Extended is a usage-control token covering training and some Gemini grounding, not a separate HTTP crawler or Google Search inclusion switch.
robots.txt is not authentication, and a user-initiated fetcher may follow different robots behavior.
